- Source SHA-256: `458b548674d123f0e35c8df67395c3e569eab80ffa6e9c4a7848a8489547d439`
- Opened all 10 contact sheets, representing one saved audio-corner crop for each of 185 Part 1–4 head pages.
- 85 icon occurrences, 100 head pages without an icon, 84 distinct printed codes (1–84).
- The sole repeated printed code is 1: Part 1 head 1/PDF21 and head 18/PDF38. PDF38 clearly says 1; relationship to audio remains unknown.
- Page guide PDF11 also demonstrates icon 28, matching main Part 2 head 37/PDF83. It is an illustrative repeat, outside the 185 heads.
- No codes were unreadable in the audited crops. Absence of an icon does not prove an audio file is absent.
- Cover PDF1 states CD and voice download are included; opened PDF13 calls the CD attached and says example sentences are Japanese only. An explicit disc count was not found; actual files were not checked.
- Download instructions PDF219–220 give `http://audiobook.jp/exchange/jresearch` and serial code `23874`: create account, enter code, receive book, then PC bookshelf download or smartphone app.
- Colophon PDF217: 清ルミ, Jリサーチ出版, 2018-05-10 first printing, ISBN 978-4-86392-387-4.
